specs.OS requirements: Bluetooth-enabled Mac with OS X 10.11 or later, iPad with iPadOS 13.4 or later

features: Optimised design lets it glide smoothly across your desk
description: Magic Mouse is wireless and rechargeable, with an optimised foot design that lets it glide smoothly across your desk. The Multi-Touch surface allows you to perform simple gestures such as swiping between web pages and scrolling through documents. The rechargeable battery will power your Magic Mouse for about a month or more between charges. It’s ready to go straight out of the box and pairs automatically with your Mac, and it includes a woven USB-C Charge Cable that lets you pair and charge by connecting to a USB-C port on your Mac.
